name: Chatham County, GA
findings: Chatham County has 935 nonprofit organizations. 374 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 285 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Chatham County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 5 hobby and sports organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 12 would.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?
